purpose: A user or assistant conversation entry with source context, progress, citations, and optional result actions.
behaviorProvider: React Markdown allowlist and shared AI/feedback components; host owns message stream.

component: Render user messages as plain text. Assistant content uses React Markdown with raw HTML skipped, an explicit allowed-element list and reduced heading levels; do not execute model-supplied HTML.
Keep partial content visible for stopped/error messages and display corresponding explanatory feedback. Streaming without content shows ThinkingIndicator and StreamingSkeleton.
host: Own streaming, cancellation, retrieval, message identity, citations and action authorization. Validate externally supplied reference URLs and content provenance.
Provide truthful evidence-step descriptions, preserve partial results and decide when feedback/regeneration is allowed.

requirements.statement: Render user messages as plain text. Assistant content uses React Markdown with raw HTML skipped, an explicit allowed-element list and reduced heading levels; do not execute model-supplied HTML.
Keep partial content visible for stopped/error messages and display corresponding explanatory feedback. Streaming without content shows ThinkingIndicator and StreamingSkeleton.
Keep the changing content region aria-live off and communicate overall response status separately. Evidence steps are an ordinary details/summary disclosure with status text.
References invoke onCitationClick when supplied; otherwise render the supplied href or plain text. Copy uses the clipboard and shows copied/error feedback bound to the copied content.
Only non-streaming messages with content show copy/feedback controls. A stopped empty response can expose regeneration when provided.
Own streaming, cancellation, retrieval, message identity, citations and action authorization. Validate externally supplied reference URLs and content provenance.
Provide truthful evidence-step descriptions, preserve partial results and decide when feedback/regeneration is allowed.

Use ai group tokens for owned presentation, preserve genuine nested component ownership, and verify the same geometry across Fundamental and Fundamental Floating in light/dark. Keep the documented semantics and state model when composing or extending this family.

limitations: Markdown restrictions are not a substitute for validating arbitrary host ReactNode content or reference hrefs.
This component does not run a model, execute tools, verify references or persist feedback.
Authored source coverage is separate from executed interaction, visual, accessibility and consumer-package evidence.
